node.text.regex.name: Regex
node.text.regex.description: Extract .NET regex matches and numbered or named groups. All matches return arrays; first-match mode uses strings for single captures and arrays for repeated captures.
node.text.match.name: Match
node.text.match.description: Return true if the .NET regular expression matches anywhere, otherwise false. Invalid patterns and timeouts are errors.
node.text.substring.name: SubString
node.text.substring.description: Extract a substring using zero-based UTF-16 indices. Omit length for the remainder; invalid ranges fail.
